title: Mate identity for normalized beta
statement: Mate substep: for a beta satisfying the specified augmentation normalization and pullback equation, the conjugated actual scalar mate equals the displayed scalar-first projection.

proof.text: Transport the normalized section adjunctions through coefficient change and apply the ring-sheaf change-adjunction identity. Substitute the pullback square and use beta naturality at the geometric counit to obtain the projection equality.
